fit.model: one integer constant for each side to move
fit.tie_break: exact binary64 loss, then (absolute score, signed score)

allowed: HORDE_WDL_CALIBRATION_V1 fitted from that exact training split

objective.calibration_mapping: trainer CPU torch.softmax over loss/draw/win logits
objective.exact_audit: float32 values scaled by 2^149; moment and histogram integer numerators must be identical
objective.mate_policy: exclude abs(teacher score) >= 31507 from the score term and retain every result term
objective.normalization: divide the composite sum by all records
objective.reduction: IEEE-754 binary64 group moments and math.fsum in ascending side and rule-50 order
